properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 29 at 11:11PM MDT until September 30 at 1:30AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
FFWEPZ

The National Weather Service in El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa has extended
the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Rio Grande between Rincon Arroyo and Leasburg Diversion Dam...
and Rincon Arroyo near Rincon.

* Until 130 AM MDT.

* At 1111 PM MDT, Water levels on the Rio Grande at Hayner's Bridge
continue to slowly drop. But flooding is still likely occurring
north of Leasburg Dam. Water levels are also continuing to drop at
Rincon Arroyo.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Gauges reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Rincon, Peaceful Valley, Selden Canyon, Rinconcito, and Radium
Springs north of Leasburg Dam.

The Rio Grande at Hayner's Bridge crested at 10.87 feet, with a flow
of 6,307 cfs, at 730 PM. It has since dropped to 10.17 feet and a
flow of 5,434 cfs as of 11 PM.

River levels continue to slowly rise at Leasburg Dam, but no flooding
is anticipated south of Leasburg due to levee protection, and higher
ground along the right bank.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 29 at 8:39PM MST until September 30 at 12:15AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:

rain fell earlier this evening. Flooding impacts will continue, but
no additional rainfall is expected.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams and
normally dry washes.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Yava and Kirkland.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 96 between mile markers 11 and 12. State Route 89 near
mile marker 293.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Kirkland Creek, Skull Valley Wash, Eastwood Creek, Little Shipp
Wash, Alkali Wash, Santa Maria River, Copper Basin Wash, Quail
Spring Wash, Tank Wash and Bland Creek.

muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.
